# Vendored Office tools

- Upstream: `dsh-office-tools` by kw78
- Upstream version: `1.0.3`
- Source: https://github.com/kw78/dsh-office-tools
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`
- Included file: `lib/index.js`, bundled upstream build

The upstream `apply()` is invoked by the single `kodbox-office-tools` entry point. It is not installed as a second DSH plugin.

Local change: the eight `presentCall` titles read `Office · <app> <action>：<path>` instead of `Create/Read/Update <path>`, so Office calls stand out in the conversation.

Local compatibility: `excel_read` accepts `.xls` and detects BIFF8 even when
incorrectly renamed `.xlsx`. Legacy parsing delegates to the bounded SheetJS
worker in `../../spreadsheet-read.js`; create/update remain native XLSX tools.

Local package compatibility fixes (2026-10-16): worksheet content types and workbook styles relationship; standard XLSX default fills/style; sparse PPT note indices and notes-master attributes; gradient stops; embedded binary slide images instead of server filesystem links. Generated packages and Word/Excel updates validate their part types and internal relationship targets; cloud uploads run the same checks. This is package-graph validation, not full OOXML schema certification. Text encoding strips invalid XML surrogate/noncharacter values. Regression fixtures are generated by `node --experimental-vm-modules tests/office-package.cjs` and checked by an independent Python XML parser and ZIP CRC verification.

Follow-up: Word and Excel now also use standard binary ZIP archives and atomic byte writes, matching PPT. The upstream ASCII-safe text ZIP writer was removed after a controlled desktop Excel reproduction: the same XML parts fail in its padded archive and open normally when repackaged. Public create-tool regression tests cover binary file writes for all three formats; generated XLSX and the unchanged-XML repack were both opened successfully in macOS Excel.

Local editing support (2026-10-21): word_read format=paragraphs returns content-bound body-paragraph IDs and editability. word_update edits supports guarded replace/delete/insert, preserving paragraph properties and the first run style; mixed run styles are flattened. Complex objects and table paragraphs are excluded. See ../../word-paragraphs.js and tests/word-edit-tools.cjs (repository tests directory).
